title: Classification of homogeneous almost complex $4$-manifolds with non-degenerate torsion bundle
summary: We investigate the local and global geometry of almost complex $4$-manifolds admitting non-degenerate torsion bundle. The rigidity of these structures forces a parallelizable $J$-adapted double cover, which imposes severe topological constraints on the underlying manifold. Exploiting this rigidity, we give a complete classification in the homogeneous setting.
